zh: DeepSeek（深度求索）
en: DeepSeek

zh: ChatGPT（OpenAI）
en: ChatGPT (OpenAI)

zh: ChatGPT 的会员订阅不包含 API 用量：API 要在 platform.openai.com 另外开通并充值。
en: A ChatGPT subscription does not include API usage: the API has to be activated and funded separately at platform.openai.com.

zh: Kimi（月之暗面）
en: Kimi (Moonshot AI)

zh: 国内站 moonshot.cn
en: China site (moonshot.cn)

zh: 国际站 moonshot.ai
en: International site (moonshot.ai)

zh: 国内站和国际站的密钥不通用：密钥是在哪个站申请的，下面的"站点"就选哪个。
en: Keys for the China site and the international site are not interchangeable: under "Site" below, choose the site where you applied for your key.

zh: 豆包（火山方舟）
en: Doubao (Volcengine Ark)

zh: 豆包
en: Doubao

zh: 模型要先在方舟控制台开通。"模型"一栏也可以填你创建的推理接入点的编号（ep- 开头）。
en: A model must first be activated in the Ark console. In the "Model" field you can also enter the ID of an inference endpoint you created (it starts with ep-).

zh: 其他（兼容 OpenAI 的接口）
en: Other (OpenAI-compatible API)

zh: 任何兼容 OpenAI Chat Completions 的接口都可以：填接口地址（到 /v1 为止）、密钥和模型名。本机的 Ollama、LM Studio 也算（例如 http://localhost:11434/v1，可以不填密钥）。
en: Any API compatible with OpenAI Chat Completions works: enter the base URL (up to /v1), the key and the model name. Ollama or LM Studio on this machine counts too (for example http://localhost:11434/v1; the key may be left empty).

zh: /content.{0,12}(risk|filter|policy)|data_inspection|inappropriate|sensitive.?content|high.?risk|flagged|moderation|prohibited|blocked due to|敏感|违规|不安全|审核/i
en: /content.{0,12}(risk|filter|policy)|data_inspection|inappropriate|sensitive.?content|high.?risk|flagged|moderation|prohibited|blocked due to|敏感|违规|不安全|审核/i

zh: /insufficient[_ ]?(balance|quota|funds|credit)|exceeded your current quota|quota.?exceeded|余额|欠费|arrearage|overdue|billing/i
en: /insufficient[_ ]?(balance|quota|funds|credit)|exceeded your current quota|quota.?exceeded|余额|欠费|arrearage|overdue|billing/i

zh: /context.?length|maximum context|too many tokens|prompt is too long|input.{0,20}too long|超出.{0,6}长度/i
en: /context.?length|maximum context|too many tokens|prompt is too long|input.{0,20}too long|超出.{0,6}长度/i

zh: /not.?(exist|found)|does not exist|invalid model|unknown model|not.?activated|NotOpen|未开通|不存在|no access/i
en: /not.?(exist|found)|does not exist|invalid model|unknown model|not.?activated|NotOpen|未开通|不存在|no access/i

zh: 还没有接入 AI。先点"接入 AI…"，选一家服务商并填上密钥。
en: No AI is connected yet. Click "Connect an AI…" first, then choose a provider and enter a key.

zh: 先选一家服务商。
en: Choose a provider first.

zh: 没有填接口地址。
en: The base URL is missing.

zh: 接口地址不对：要以 http:// 或 https:// 开头，而且不能指向本网站。
en: The base URL is invalid: it must start with http:// or https://, and it must not point to this website.

zh: 没有填模型的名字。
en: The model name is missing.

zh: 没有填密钥。
en: The key is missing.

zh: 密钥里有不该出现的字符（中文、全角符号等），请重新复制一遍。
en: The key contains characters that should not be there (Chinese characters, full-width symbols and the like). Please copy it again.

zh: 转发代理的地址不对：要以 http:// 或 https:// 开头，而且不能指向本网站。
en: The forwarding proxy's address is invalid: it must start with http:// or https://, and it must not point to this website.

zh: 服务商不认这把密钥：可能是密钥填错了、已经作废，或者这把密钥属于另一个站点。
en: The provider does not accept this key: the key may have been entered incorrectly, it may have been revoked, or it may belong to a different site.

zh: 账号的余额或额度不够了，要到服务商那里充值。
en: The account's balance or quota has run out; you need to top it up with the provider.

zh: 调用太频繁，或者达到了服务商给这个账号的限速。过一会儿再试。
en: Too many calls, or the rate limit the provider sets for this account has been reached. Try again in a while.

zh: 服务商不认识这个模型的名字，或者这个账号还没有开通它。到设置里点"获取模型列表"换一个。
en: The provider does not recognize this model name, or this account has not activated the model yet. In Settings, click "Fetch model list" and pick another one.

zh: 接口地址不对（服务商回答"没有这个地址"）。检查设置里的接口地址。
en: The base URL is wrong (the provider answered "no such address"). Check the base URL in Settings.

zh: 发送的内容超出了这个模型的长度上限。换一个上下文更长的模型，或者把自己写的代码改短一些。
en: The content sent exceeds this model's length limit. Switch to a model with a longer context, or shorten the code you wrote.

zh: 服务商的内容审核拦下了这次请求，换个说法试试。
en: The provider's content moderation blocked this request. Try rephrasing it.

zh: 服务商不接受这个请求的格式。换一个模型试试；用的是"其他"接口时，确认它兼容 OpenAI 的 Chat Completions。
en: The provider does not accept the format of this request. Try another model; if you are using an "Other" API, make sure it is compatible with OpenAI Chat Completions.

zh: 等了很久没有回音，已经放弃。可以再试一次，或者换一个更快的模型。
en: No response after a long wait, so the request was abandoned. You can try again, or switch to a faster model.

zh: 服务商那边出了错。过一会儿再试。
en: Something went wrong on the provider's side. Try again in a while.

zh: 模型没有给出回答。再试一次，或者把要求说得更具体一些。
en: The model gave no answer. Try again, or make the request more specific.

zh: 转发代理拒绝了这次请求：这个网站或者这家服务商不在它的允许名单里。
en: The forwarding proxy refused this request: this website or this provider is not on its allowlist.

zh: 请求没有发出去。可能是网络不通，也可能是这家服务商不允许网页直接调用（浏览器的跨域限制）。后一种情况要在设置的"高级"里填一个转发代理。
en: The request was not sent. The network may be down, or this provider may not allow calls directly from a web page (the browser's cross-origin restriction). In the latter case, enter a forwarding proxy under "Advanced" in Settings.

zh: 请求没有发出去：这家服务商不允许网页直接调用（浏览器的跨域限制）。要在设置的"高级"里填一个转发代理。
en: The request was not sent: this provider does not allow calls directly from a web page (the browser's cross-origin restriction). Enter a forwarding proxy under "Advanced" in Settings.

zh: 连不上转发代理。检查设置里代理的地址，以及代理是不是还在运行。
en: Cannot connect to the forwarding proxy. Check the proxy's address in Settings, and whether the proxy is still running.

zh: 出错了§0§。
en: Something went wrong§0§.
